title: Living Superweapon — native gameplay showcase
scope: Work-in-progress gameplay from native-input Practice recordings. Targets are passive practice constructs, not hostile AI combat evidence.
audio: Silent. Source clips contain video only; no music or sound effects were added.

editing.alterations: Trims, proportional downscale, letterbox where needed, text labels, dissolves, opening/closing fades. No generated footage, gameplay alterations, camera repositioning, or time remapping.

clips.label: FLIGHT / ALTITUDE
clips.shows: Running, takeoff, prone forward flight, turning and hovering above the practice ground.

clips.label: BUILT WORLD / TRAVERSAL
clips.shows: Native keyboard flight across the existing environment toward a building and its rooftop.

clips.label: PRECISION FIRE
clips.shows: Aiming and rifle shots toward passive range targets, with in-game hit feedback.

clips.label: SUSTAINED BEAM / IMPACT
clips.shows: A held beam contacting a passive practice target, damage feedback and the in-game KO camera.

limitations: Edited excerpts from separate recorded sessions; not one continuous match.
These recordings do not establish hostile-AI behavior, airborne melee, grapple or production network play.
Background aircraft can appear incidentally; aircraft gameplay is not featured.
Loading and editor portions of the source recordings are excluded.
